summary: No role cleared every hard gate on November 13. Four AI-related roles that are new on this site publish no salary, so they are near-misses, not picks. GitLab is hiring a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, remote with France named, who helps large customers adopt its Duo Agent Platform for AI agents. Mistral AI posted two Paris roles: one owns the tokenizers and model-interface libraries behind every model it ships, the other builds training data, evaluations and agent harnesses for engineering software. Neural Concept is hiring a Paris-based forward deployed engineer to apply its 3D deep-learning platform to customers' engineering problems. These entries are research leads, not recommendations.
coverage: Automated official-ATS sweep on November 13: 130 of 276 attempted Ashby, Lever and Greenhouse board aliases returned data; many failed aliases are likely wrong board names, not evidence of no vacancies. The sweep screened AI-titled roles on reachable boards, Paris- or France-located engineering roles with published pay, and Ashby engineering roles first published since November 10. Compared with November 12, the new AI-related requisitions in that screen were GitLab's Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA and Mistral AI's two November 12 roles. Vibe's new Paris Senior Software Engineer, Supply role (€90,000–€125,000 base) builds ad-inventory backend systems and is not AI-central. About ten web searches surfaced Neural Concept and other leads. Leads were checked on employer or ATS pages before inclusion. Coverage is bounded, not exhaustive.
criteria: Paris hybrid with explicit attendance, or fully remote explicitly allowing France-based applicants.
Senior/staff hands-on AI-central engineering; an AI employer, coding assistant use or AI product UI alone does not establish the required assignment.

Employer-published annual gross cash-base lower bound strictly above €100,000, or at least €80,000 with explicit equity. Use the lower bound; equity is not cash; packages, OTE, unlabelled pay ranges and estimates do not pass.
No unchanged prior selections. Requisition identity takes precedence over refreshed titles, URLs or timestamps; historical qualification is not current-live verification.
uncertainty: Sources checked November 13, 2026. Missing salary on the four near-misses means pay is unknown, not that it fails the threshold.

Revolut's Senior AI Platform Engineer (Serverless Training and Inference) role, which builds GPU training and inference platforms, is shown on job aggregators as remote in several countries including France. The copies reproduce published ranges for Poland, Austria (€120,700–€184,000) and Lithuania only, with “Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process”, so no France figure is published. Revolut's own careers page stopped at a browser security check today, so the role was not verified and is not listed.

SecretSauce Labs' Senior AI Agent Engineer (€120,000–€150,000 plus equity, “Remote, Europe”) appears only on a third-party recruiting platform. No employer careers page or ATS listing was found, and France is not named, so it was not listed.

Salary figures that appear only on job aggregators were not counted. Examples seen today: €110,000–€150,000 for Mistral AI's Forward Software Engineer (the same requisition listed here on November 7, since retitled “Applied AI, Frontier Engineering, Staff”), €120,000–€150,000 for Shift Technology's Staff AI Engineer (a near-miss here on October 23) and €110,000–€170,000 for a Doctolib Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Applied AI & LLMs listing. The employers' own job data for these roles publish no pay.
Mistral AI re-published its “AI Scientist, Agentic CAD” requisition on November 12 (a near-miss here on November 3); the requisition is unchanged in pay and policy, so it was not re-listed.

Not re-listed: Seedtag's and Alice & Bob's near-misses from November 12 were not re-checked today. Inato's Senior AI Engineer (qualified October 26) and OpenAI Deployment Company's Forward Deployed Engineer – EU (qualified October 18) still appear in their employers' job data with unchanged pay; they are archived picks, not new ones, and were not re-verified in full today.
Deduplication covered the accessible October 10 to November 12 reports and the supplied October 3/5 Escape history.
decision: No approval needed for this authorized daily website update. No role qualified today. The four near-misses would need an employer-published salary (and, for three of them, a clear attendance rule) before they could pass. No applications or outreach were made.

jobs.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA
jobs.locationQuote: Official listing: “Remote Ireland; Remote, Austria; Remote, France; Remote, Germany; Remote, Netherlands; Remote, Spain; Remote, United Kingdom”, and “All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements.” France is named explicitly.[1][2]

salary.quote: No salary or equity term is published on the listing, and Greenhouse's pay-transparency data for this job is empty. Pay is unknown, not below the threshold.[1][2]

reasons: Pay gate unverified: no employer-published base salary or equity.[1][2]
Location passes on employer wording: remote, with France named among the seven eligible countries.[1]

Seniority passes (Staff title; the listing asks for the “technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer”). AI centrality is partial: driving production adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform is one of four duty areas, alongside production code contributions, strategic customer troubleshooting and thought leadership. The listing asks for strong Ruby on Rails or Go.[1]

New requisition, first published November 12, 2026; the same-page application form loaded on the check date. A similar GitLab role (Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic SDLC, requisition 8522265002) was a near-miss here on October 19; that requisition's job data now returns “not found”.[1][2]
jobs.product: Employer-stated: GitLab sells a DevSecOps platform. GitLab Duo Agent Platform is its agent layer: built-in and custom agents and flows for planning, coding, security analysis and pipelines, triggered from GitLab events, with policy controls over which agents and models may run and a trace of every agent action. This role helps strategic customers adopt it safely and feeds what it learns back into the product. Specific customer projects are not named.[1][3]

No office-day rule is stated for office-based hires.[4][5]

Seniority gate unverified: the title and listing state no level or years of experience.[4]

AI centrality passes: the engineer designs, builds and maintains the tokenization and model-interface libraries used across pretraining, post-training and deployment, so that training, evaluation and production use the same formats.[4]
